name: Math SFT transfer suite (Qwen2.5-Math protocol)
description: Measures how much a small supervised fine-tuning dataset improves a base language model on mathematical reasoning. A method submits an SFT dataset; the suite fine-tunes a fixed base model on it and scores the result on eight held-out math benchmarks under the Qwen2.5-Math chain-of-thought evaluation protocol. The score attributable to the method is the delta over the untrained base model measured under identical generation settings.

dataset.notes: The suite evaluates eight test sets, all registered under datasets/: gsm8k, hendrycks-math, aime24, aime25, amc23, minerva-math, olympiadbench, gaokao2024-mix. registry_id names gsm8k as the primary reference because the schema carries one field; see each dataset directory for provenance and HuggingFace mirror information.
